business_outcome: Improve existing Run 014 website implementation quality from a protected accepted baseline toward premium/Lovable-quality output by correcting evaluator calibration and adding one bounded before-vs-after implementation-refinement pass, without moving upstream commercial strategy or new art-direction ownership into Run 014.
existing_owner_scan: Website Business remains the upstream commercial/creative owner. Run 014 already owns implementation fidelity, browser evidence, visual implementation QA, security review, repair and release-candidate packaging. Run 015 remains frozen. The residual gap is calibrated implementation-quality judgment and the ability to refine an already-approved implementation baseline without regenerating the site from zero.
reuse_candidates_checked: Run 015 remains frozen and is not a candidate executor
duplication_analysis: EXTEND Run 014 rather than reactivate Run 015 or create another team. The new refinement mode starts from a hash-locked accepted implementation baseline and may improve composition, hierarchy, spacing, component presentation, responsive polish and use of already-approved assets within the upstream creative direction. It may not invent a replacement brand strategy, market positioning, unapproved content, new external assets, or a new art direction.
residual_unowned_loop: Frozen approved implementation baseline -> calibrated before score/evidence -> one bounded implementation-refinement candidate -> deterministic source/function preservation -> after screenshots -> independent before-vs-after comparison -> PASS only if materially improved and premium threshold is satisfied; otherwise retain frozen baseline and report REVISE/FAIL.
evidence_ref: Capable Hands Run 014 v0.4 WC-20260829003113-18392db183; owner-approved recommendation to freeze the visible baseline and improve evaluator/refinement capability; baseline CHC-R014-V04-20260829.

anchors.60: usable/coherent but visibly generic or flawed
anchors.75: credible modern commercial site with meaningful repetition or polish gaps
anchors.85: strong production-quality commercial implementation with only a few material polish gaps
anchors.92: premium agency/Lovable-quality implementation with refined composition, varied visual storytelling, excellent responsive behavior and no material visual defects
anchors.96: exceptional distinctive portfolio/reference quality with meticulous detail

calibration_policy.singleDigitFallback: If a model emits a non-zero score <=10, runtime normalizes it to the corresponding 0-100 value and records the raw score.

promotion_constraints: The frozen baseline must be verified by exact HTML/CSS SHA-256 before refinement begins.
Refinement must fork; ordinary repair may not overwrite the frozen baseline.
Verified facts, approved links/assets, semantic/accessibility invariants and business functionality must remain unchanged unless the approved upstream handoff explicitly permits a change.
Before and after viewport plus full-page screenshots are mandatory.
Independent comparison must judge before versus after, not only an abstract score.
A refinement candidate that regresses deterministic invariants is rejected and the frozen baseline remains authoritative.
Premium target is >=92 on the calibrated 0-100 scale plus no material browser/accessibility/security/challenger blockers.
Preview deployment remains a separate approval-gated action.
